original_card.question: Does one explicit extension of the connector alphabet offer a favorable completed budget?
methods: Construct and charge a legal extra operation on a minimal instance.
Prove a target-specific bound after adding one specified operation family.
original_card.acceptance_gate: State which fixed-alphabet premise changes and charge its implementation; do not declare it free.

first_step.inspect: Reproduce the 945-pairing control, then read Exact interface to list the allowed calls.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Add exactly one legally priced operation and test a tiny dirty-input instance before enumerating larger cases.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A new legal connector operation could change recursive interface cost; a larger census in the same alphabet is a separate side result.
allowed_variations: Choose one additional operation and a small source count for its first counterexample.
scope_change_triggers: Keeping the alphabet and only increasing the source count; record this as a changed assignment.

actual_scope: In the PR1438/PR1498 free-port two-connector family, independently re-certify the PR1615 eight-transfer threshold with a standard-library census and classify every eight-transfer schedule: how many are there, and which port splits attain eight?
scope_change_reason: The card asks whether one explicit alphabet extension has a favorable completed budget. PR1438/PR1498 introduced and priced this extension; PR1615 (bbMisk), published concurrently, settled its exact threshold of eight. This package keeps the extension and adds the complete solution set at eight (2,502 schedules, only port splits r = 1 and r = 5), a stdlib certificate of the exclusion that fits the generic package hook, and the exact four-transfer split maxima (PR1498 r = 2 bound 25 is not attained).
bottleneck_link: Side result: pins down the full solution space of the cheapest two-connector repair (completed price 72c + 8 sigma + H_new) and shows free source ports enlarge it without saving a transfer. No kappa change.
stop_rule: Stop once the t = 6 exclusion and t = 8 attainment are exhaustive with a stdlib registered engine that reproduces the PR943 and PR1438 censuses, every universal schedule replays literally, and an independent full-placement engine agrees; do not extend to extra-incidence families.
evidence: verify.py (stdlib) reproduces PR943 n=4,5 and PR1438 n=1..5 censuses bin for bin; finds no universal schedule at t = 4 or 6 over all 945 words and 32 port splits (t = 6 maxima equal PR1615); and finds exactly 2,502 universal schedules at t = 8 (r = 1: 2,376; r = 5: 126; digest ba04f277...), each replaying as an 80-call program on dense random F2 maps. The independent full-placement census.c agrees at t = 4, 6, 8 and reproduces PR1615 t = 6 totals 242,161,920 / 74,692,800.
